content:
maria: Quick heads-up — SLO dashboard for Acme is live in staging. Need a 15m walkthrough with their CSM tomorrow 09:00 PT.
jake: Awesome. Is uptime calc final? Which latency percentiles are we showing (p95/p99)? :thumbsup:
lina: I added the creditable_incident flag when region outage > 5m. Still need to align on exact credit formula and cap.
ryan_sre: FYI alerting thresholds set: latency p95 warning=200ms / critical=300ms. uptime warning at 99.98%.
maria: Uptime = successful_requests / total_requests over rolling 30d window. Contract target = 99.95%. Latency targets we proposed: p95 <= 250ms, p99 <= 800ms.
jake: Demo link: https://app.redwood.ai/dashboards/acme-slos?env=prod
(also can export CSV from the top-right)
maria: Quick credit calc proposal for the walkthrough: credit = max(0, (target - observed) / target) * monthly_commit. Example: target 99.95% vs observed 99.70% => ~0.25% of monthly commit (round to nearest $10).
lina: Note: per contract we cap monthly credits at 10% of monthly commit. Also exclude maintenance windows we pre-notify.
maria: Action items before walkthrough — can we get these by EOD?
- jake: add dashboard annotations showing contract windows + a worked credit example
- ryan_sre: confirm alerting window behavior and run a staging test for a 6m outage (post logs)
- lina: draft a one-page customer-facing explainer (what metrics mean, credit formula, examples)
- maria: schedule walkthrough, attach one-pager to invite and send to CSM + TAM
jake: I'll add the annotations and a small hover text with formula. ETA 15:00 PT.
ryan_sre: I'll simulate and post the incident snippet at 14:00 PT, will include traces and service logs.
lina: Drafting one-pager now. I'll drop a preview in #customer-success and attach a PDF to the invite.
opsbot: deploy pipeline: dashboard-staging -> prod promotion scheduled at 16:00 UTC. status: pending manual approval.
maria: Also please include a short 'what changed' note (e.g., KV cache warm-up, batching tuning) to explain transient p95 blips.
jake: Added annotation: "recent KV cache warm-up may cause short p95 blips during warm windows".
maria: Great — thanks everyone :heart: I'll post the final calendar invite and include the one-pager. Walkthrough set for 09:00 PT tomorrow with Acme CSM + TAM.
_test_note: Contains single Slack thread. Messages are short and in chronological order per agents.md rules.
